name: android-harmony-migration-controller
title: Android-Harmony Migration Controller
job_to_be_done: Coordinate an auditable Android-to-HarmonyOS migration through Phases 1-4 with frozen inputs, specialist work orders, deterministic machine gates, mandatory human review, and governed rework. Use for one-shot workflow requests or phase governance; do not inspect Android UI or implement HarmonyOS application code in the controller role.

trigger_surface.description: Coordinate an auditable Android-to-HarmonyOS migration through Phases 1-4 with frozen inputs, specialist work orders, deterministic machine gates, mandatory human review, and governed rework. Use for one-shot workflow requests or phase governance; do not inspect Android UI or implement HarmonyOS application code in the controller role.
should_trigger: Run or govern an Android-to-HarmonyOS migration task.
Validate a phase gate and prepare the human checkpoint.
should_not_trigger: Implement ArkTS page code in the controller role.

steps: Freeze scope, source, environments, actors, and exclusions.
Issue only the current specialist work order.
Recompute the canonical machine gate and generate an exception-first review summary.
Enter WAITING_HUMAN_REVIEW and stop the task.
Issue the next work order only after an allowed human decision is bound to the current gate report SHA256.
decision_points: Machine failure routes to governed rework.
REWORK or MANUAL_TAKEOVER prevents forward progress.
APPROVED or APPROVED_DEVIATION permits the next task only when current and valid.
failure_modes: A later phase opens without current human approval.
A model declares completion from prose instead of canonical evidence.
An approval is stale or bound to a different gate report.

risk.trust_boundary: external identity and authorization; local SHA binding provides integrity and stale-review detection only
